_comment: Sizes are [studs across, plates high, studs long]. A brick is three plates high. Mass is in kg, power in watts, push and thrust in newtons. Strength is how hard a part has to be hit before it comes off, as an impulse in newton seconds (a 100 kg kart hitting a wall at 10 m/s is roughly 1000, shared between the parts that touch it). The seat never comes off, so the driver always stays in. Gadgets cost studs to use (cost 0 means always on), and a kart can carry two. Aero says how smoothly air gets past a part's front and back, as it's placed with no turn (the front is toward -Z). 1 is a flat face and smaller is smoother. Off-road is how much of the grip a tire loses on grass and dirt it keeps anyway, so 0.6 keeps most of it and a negative number loses even more. Control is how quickly the driver can steer from that seat or with that steering, as a fraction. Driver height is how many plates of the driver stick up above the seat.

slope_2x2.name: Slope 2x2
slope_2x2.about: A brick with its front sloped off, so the air slides over it. Turn it around and it smooths the back instead.

slope_long_2x4.name: Long slope 2x4
slope_long_2x4.about: A long gentle slope, smoother than a steep one.

slope_inverted_2x2.name: Inverted slope 2x2
slope_inverted_2x2.about: Sloped underneath, for tucking in under a nose.

curve_2x4.name: Curved slope 2x4
curve_2x4.about: A smooth curved slope with no studs, like the bonnet of a sports car.

nose_2x2.name: Nose cone 2x2
nose_2x2.about: Rounded all over, so it cuts through the air better than anything. It works as a tail cone too.

wedge_left_4x6.name: Wedge plate 4x6 left
wedge_left_4x6.about: A plate cut to a point, for a pointy nose. Pair it with the right one.

fender_2x4.name: Mudguard 2x4
fender_2x4.about: Goes over a wheel. It looks the part and keeps a little air off the tire.

wheel_fairing_1.name: Wheel fairing, narrow
wheel_fairing_1.about: Clips onto the side of the kart in front of a wheel, like a wheel clips on, so the air goes around the tire instead of into it.

wheel_fairing_2.name: Wheel fairing, wide
wheel_fairing_2.about: The same, for a wide wheel.

side_pod.name: Side pod
side_pod.about: Clips onto the side of the kart and smooths the air along it, and past the back wheels.

seat.name: Driver's seat
seat.about: Sits the driver upright. They see everything and steer quickly, but a lot of them sticks up into the wind.

engine_small.name: Small engine
engine_small.about: A plain little engine that gets any kart going.

engine_big.name: Big engine
engine_big.about: More power for a bigger kart, and more weight to carry.

engine_micro.name: Micro engine
engine_micro.about: Tiny and light. Not much power, but a featherweight kart doesn't need much.

electric_motor.name: Electric motor
electric_motor.about: Quiet and light, and it pushes hardest from a standstill. It runs out of puff at top speed.

engine_twin.name: Twin engine
engine_twin.about: Two cylinders. A good step up from the small engine without the big one's weight.

engine_diesel.name: Diesel
engine_diesel.about: Heavy and slow to rev, but it shoves like nothing else, up hills and through grass.

engine_v8.name: Racing V8
engine_v8.about: The most power there is, in a heavy engine that doesn't take knocks well.

jet.name: Jet engine
jet.about: Pushes the kart along by itself instead of through the wheels, so it keeps pushing on grass and ice. It doesn't reverse.

wheel_tiny.name: Tiny wheel
wheel_tiny.about: Small and light, for a kart that sits right down on the road.

wheel_slick.name: Slick
wheel_slick.about: No tread at all, so it grips the road better than any other tire. On grass it's hopeless.

wheel_knobbly.name: Knobbly wheel
wheel_knobbly.about: Chunky tread that bites into grass and dirt. It's a bit slow on the road.

wheel_big.name: Big wheel
wheel_big.about: Tall and narrow, so it rolls easily and rides over bumps.

wheel_skinny.name: Skinny wheel
wheel_skinny.about: Like a bicycle wheel. It rolls further than anything and barely grips.

wheel_monster.name: Monster wheel
wheel_monster.about: Huge. It goes over anything, and lifts the kart up high where it rolls in corners.

front_wing_6x2.name: Front wing
front_wing_6x2.about: A low wing across the front that presses the front wheels down.

rear_wing_6x2.name: Big rear wing
rear_wing_6x2.about: A big wing up on stilts, in clean air. Lots of grip in fast corners, and lots of drag.

steering_wheel.name: Steering wheel
steering_wheel.about: Goes in front of the seat so the driver can steer. Lose it in a crash and you can't steer until you reset.

handlebars.name: Handlebars
handlebars.about: Like a steering wheel, but wider, so the driver can steer a little quicker.

bucket_seat.name: Bucket seat
bucket_seat.about: Sits the driver lower and leaning back a little. Less of them catches the wind, and the kart sits lower.

lay_down_seat.name: Lay-down seat
lay_down_seat.about: The driver lies nearly flat, like on a luge. Hardly any of them is in the wind, but it's harder to steer lying down.

yoke.name: Yoke
yoke.about: A low flat-topped steering wheel that tucks in under a windscreen.

windscreen_2.name: Windscreen 2x1
windscreen_2.about: See-through, and sloped back. Put it in front of the driver and the wind goes over their head.

turbo.name: Turbo
turbo.about: A burst of extra push for a second and a half.

spring.name: Spring
spring.about: Hops the kart into the air, over trouble or onto a shortcut.

brick_dropper.name: Brick dropper
brick_dropper.about: Leaves a pile of loose bricks behind you for whoever's following.

brick_cannon.name: Brick cannon
brick_cannon.about: Fires a brick straight ahead. Whoever it hits loses a part.

repair_kit.name: Repair kit
repair_kit.about: Puts back everything you've lost, without the reset slowdown.

shield.name: Shield
shield.about: For four seconds nothing can knock your parts off.

ram_plate.name: Ram plate
ram_plate.about: Always on. Hit another kart with it and their parts come off far more easily. It's very hard to knock off.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.about: Always on. Picks up studs from much further away.
